column20:
The numbers indicate our situation in the EU market.
Our moderation team works 365 days a year supporting multiple languages, and makes a judgement within 24 hours upon the receipt of the report in principle.
column24:
The numbers indicate our situation in the EU market.
Nintendo in principle has two measures to take in cases where it confirms content is problematic: (1) deletion or blocking access to user-generated content (“UGC removal”) and/or (2) restriction of an application’s online functionalities (“application ban”).
All UGC removal and application bans are taken on the basis of our terms and conditions, including Nintendo Account Agreement, which prohibits any illegal, harmful or otherwise inappropriate conduct when using the Nintendo Account service.
